title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: When dealing with matrices in OLS, it's important to remember that the dimensions of the matrices involved in the calculations must align properly. Consider how the number of features, including the intercept, affects the shape of the parameter vector.

title: Parameter Vector Shape
text: The parameter vector, often denoted as theta, includes coefficients for each feature plus the intercept. Think about how many coefficients you would have if you have $$p$$ features.
